Network Engineer
 The Network Engineer in ACROM is responsible for designing, implementing, configuring, maintaining and troubleshooting the network infrastructure of the company’s customers to meet business objectives and SLAs. The role is aimed at an engineer with solid hands-on experience who can work independently on day-to-day operations and customer projects, while continuing to grow alongside our senior engineers and the new technologies we adopt.
 Experience and profile: 
 ü 3–5 years of hands-on experience in enterprise networking (operations, implementation and/or projects)
 ü Able to handle standard implementations, changes and incidents independently, escalating complex issues to senior engineers and supporting junior colleagues when needed
 Technical skills: 
 ü Switching & LAN: design, configuration and troubleshooting of enterprise LANs – VLANs and 802.1Q trunking, Rapid PVST+/MST, LACP/EtherChannel, inter-VLAN routing, switch stacking, PoE and port security
 ü IP services: IPv4 addressing, subnetting and IP plan design, IPv6 awareness, NAT/PAT, DHCP, DNS, NTP, SNMP and Syslog
 ü Routing: static and dynamic routing – OSPF (multi-area) and BGP (eBGP with ISPs, path attributes, route filtering), route redistribution, first-hop redundancy (HSRP/VRRP) and policy-based routing
 ü Network security: firewall policies and security zones, NAT on firewalls, site-to-site IPsec and remote-access VPN, 802.1X/RADIUS/NAC, AAA (TACACS+/RADIUS), segmentation of guest, IoT and payment networks, device hardening
 ü Wireless: enterprise WLAN deployment and troubleshooting – 2.4/5/6 GHz, channel and power planning, roaming, WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise, guest access and captive portals, site surveys
 ü WAN & SD-WAN: MPLS, internet and LTE/5G uplinks, dual-WAN failover, SD-WAN path selection and policies, QoS for voice and video (classification, marking, queuing)
 ü Cisco: hands-on experience with Cisco routers, Catalyst switches and wireless (IOS / IOS-XE), including configuration, software upgrades and troubleshooting; experience with Cisco Meraki (MX, MS, MR) is an advantage
 ü Monitoring & troubleshooting: structured troubleshooting across all OSI layers using NMS/monitoring tools (e.g. PRTG, Zabbix, SolarWinds or similar), SNMP, Syslog, NetFlow and packet capture (Wireshark)
 ü Design & documentation: high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), IP plans, network diagrams (Visio or similar), change and rollback plans
 ü Certifications: CCNA or equivalent experience; CCNP Enterprise or other professional-level certifications are a plus
 Nice to have: 
 ü Juniper experience: Junos OS (EX switches, SRX firewalls) and/or Juniper Mist cloud-managed wireless and wired networks
 ü Juniper certifications (JNCIA / JNCIP) or Juniper Mist certifications
 ü Experience with other firewall vendors (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto) or other cloud-managed platforms
 ü Network automation and scripting (Python, Ansible, REST APIs)
 Learning and adaptability: 
 ü Curiosity and a real drive to learn new technologies, such as cloud-managed networking, SD-WAN, SASE / zero-trust and network automation
 ü Proven ability to ramp up quickly on new vendors, platforms and customer environments
 ü Proactive in pursuing certifications and keeping up with industry trends
 ü Open to feedback and willing to share knowledge with the team
 Soft skills: 
 ü Strong organizational skills and ability to multi-task across several customers and projects
 ü Clear communication with customers, vendors and colleagues, and the discipline to document work (designs, procedures, change records)
 ü Very good command of English
 Day-to-day work: 
 ü Design, installation and configuration of LAN/WAN and wireless networks for the company’s customers, working with senior engineers on complex designs
 ü Implement and support network infrastructure solutions from different vendors, mainly Cisco (including Meraki), and Juniper where applicable
 ü Installation and configuration of network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, access points, wireless controllers, network monitoring tools)
 ü Configuration changes on network devices and network applications based on the existing change management process
 ü Monitor network and systems health, responding appropriately to network alerts and events to diagnose and troubleshoot network issues
 ü Provide information and recommendations regarding network configurations and installations
 ü Interact with vendors and third parties (e.g. Cisco TAC, ISPs) for problem resolution
 ü Maintain multi-site network operations with both private and public facilities
 ü Manage assigned projects and program components to deliver services in accordance with established objectives
 ü Evaluate and pilot new technologies and tools, and help introduce them into customer environments
 ü Create and maintain technical documentation for customer networks
 What we offer: 
 ü Access to courses and certifications (Cisco, Juniper and more) depending on the need
 ü Opportunity to learn and work with a variety of technologies in international projects 
 ü Flexible business hours and work from home 
 ü Real possibility to make a difference in a dynamic company with an entrepreneurial spirit 
 ü Real possibilities of promotion within the company 
 ü Annual performance bonus 
 ü Package of medical services supported by the company 
 ü Transport from the office to the subway Pipera or Aurel Vlaicu, provided by the company
